title: Learner 01 | Day 109: Images, audio, and untrusted media
body:
## Goal

Accept a small synthetic image for a study-note draft through a media adapter; keep a text fallback and no automatic publication.

## Implementation contract

**File:** `src/learnforge/adapters/connections/model_runtime.py`

**Method/unit:** `handle_media_draft`

**Why here:** This translates an external representation or service: raw input, HTTP/provider/protocol behavior, and error translation belong outside the core.

**Inputs and expected outputs:** Unsupported or oversized media fails; source IDs stay attached; extracted text is untrusted input.

**Boundaries:** Own parsing/transport only; delegate domain decisions and storage.

## Research hints

1. Research **Images, audio, and untrusted media**. Which rule explains your named unit’s behavior?
2. Search `site:huggingface.co/docs Images audio and untrusted media`; use [Hugging Face LLM course](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1) for the relevant small section.
3. Predict one changed input/timing case, run it, and explain each changed value before applying the finding.

## Done

- [ ] Demonstrate this unit’s normal and boundary/failure cases in the working feature.
- [ ] Show the actual run and explain one changed case using concrete values.

**Question of the Day:** What happens if a worker finishes its write but crashes before acknowledging the message?

**Review with @bitsnbyt3s:** run the named unit; show actual output and each relevant line’s purpose, before/after values and project contribution.
